reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.description: What people who lived in your buildings say. Only someone who stayed under one of your leases can write a review, and the getproperty team checks each one before it is public.
reviews.howBody: You can reply publicly to each review and report one that breaks the rules. Hiding or removing a review is up to the getproperty moderators only — never the owner. Reviewers' names, units and exact dates are never shown.

empty.title: No reviews yet
empty.description: Residents can review a building after they move out, or after a few months of living there.

actions.replyHint: Everyone who reads the review sees your reply under it. Keep it factual and polite.
actions.replyRules: Up to 1,000 characters. No phone numbers, e-mail, LINE IDs, links or account numbers.
actions.reportTitle: Report this review to the moderators
actions.reportHint: The review stays public while the getproperty team looks at it. Tell them what breaks the rules — e.g. false facts, insults or someone's personal data.

energy.title: Energy insight
energy.description: How efficiently this building uses electricity, from its meters' hourly data.

penalties.title: What took points off
penalties.note: The score model is provisional and may change with getenergy.

insufficient.title: Not enough data yet
insufficient.body: We have {days, plural, =0 {no days} one {# day} other {# days}} of hourly electricity data in this window. The score appears once the building's meters have reported for long enough.

share.title: Share with getenergy
share.what: getenergy, Collective's energy service, can suggest savings (solar, pumps, tariffs). Only totals are shared: the score, the figures above, the province and district, and the building's size band — never names, contacts, unit numbers or anyone's use.
share.ownerOnly: Only the building's owner can choose to share its figures. You can read the score.
share.agree: I have read the text above and agree to share this building's figures with getenergy
share.noText: The consent text is not available right now. Try again later.
share.stopBody: Nothing more is sent, anything waiting is cancelled and getenergy is asked to delete what it received.

textChanged.title: The consent text has changed
textChanged.body: We have loaded the new text above. Please read it again and tick the box if you agree.

assistant.title: Draft with AI
assistant.intro: A title and description written from this listing's own facts. Check every detail before you save.
assistant.photosHint: The first photos are read to describe the room. They are never changed.
assistant.noPhotos: Add photos first to use them.
assistant.nothingSaved: Nothing is saved until you press Save.
assistant.exhausted: This month's drafts are used up.
assistant.used: Draft copied into the form — check it, then save
assistant.zhNote: The listing keeps Thai and English only; post the Chinese text yourself where you share the listing.
assistant.photosUsed: {count, plural, one {# photo was read.} other {# photos were read.}}
assistant.off: AI drafts are switched off for your account.

limit_reached.title: Monthly drafts used up
limit_reached.body: Your account has used this month's AI drafts. You can still write the listing yourself; the count starts again next month.

unavailable.title: The AI service is not available
unavailable.body: Nothing was counted. Try again in a few minutes, or write the text yourself.

output_rejected.title: The draft was not usable
output_rejected.body: It contained contact or account details, so we did not show it. Try again — it did not count towards your drafts.

disabled.title: AI drafts are switched off
disabled.body: The getproperty team has switched the assistant off for now.
